records.text: Represent a set of the ordered pairs in the form of an arrow diagram.

records.quote: The expression " read" connects some of the elements of the set
records.claim: The expression "read" connects some elements of set X with elements of set Y and determines a relation between X and Y, denoted by the symbol R. It can be represented by an arrow diagram, drawing an arrow from the student to the type of books he reads.

records.quote: as shown in the opposite figure
records.caption: Arrow diagram from X={a,b,c,d,e} to Y={Science, art, culture, history}. Arrows: a→Science, a→culture, b→history, c→culture(?), e→history; d has no arrow. Y lists 'art' where text says literature.
records.notes: Arrows read from small figure; verify. Label 'art' vs text 'literature'.

records.quote: This set of ordered pairs are called the relation R.
records.claim: The set of ordered pairs {(a, Science), (a, Culture), (b, Histrory), (c, Literature), (e, History)} expresses the relation from X to Y and is called the relation R.

records.quote: The relation from X to Y where X, Y are two non-empty sets
records.claim: A relation from X to Y, where X and Y are two non-empty sets, connects some or all elements of X with some or all elements of Y.

records.quote: X × Y is the set of ordered pairs where the first projection
records.claim: X × Y is the set of ordered pairs where the first projection in each pair belongs to X and the second projection belongs to Y.

records.quote: If R is a relation from X to Y , then R ⊂ X × Y
records.claim: If R is a relation from X to Y, then R is a subset of X × Y.

records.quote: The relation from a set to itself
records.text: The relation from a set to itself

records.quote: If R is a relation from a set X to X (itself) then R is called a relation
records.claim: If R is a relation from a set X to X (itself), then R is called a relation on X, and R ⊂ X × X.

objectives.label: Write a relation from X to Y as ordered pairs
objectives.description: Describe a relation R between two sets, such as 'read', as a set of ordered pairs and recognize it as a subset of X × Y.

objectives.label: Represent a relation by an arrow diagram
objectives.description: Draw an arrow from each element of X to the element(s) of Y it is related to.

objectives.label: Represent a relation by a cartesian diagram
objectives.description: Plot the ordered pairs of a relation as points on a graph with X and Y marked on the axes.

objectives.label: Find and represent a relation on a set
objectives.description: Write and draw a relation from a set X to itself, where R ⊂ X × X, using a rule such as additive inverse.
